config.description: Optional. Your Supabase project URL, read by check_rls. Sent only to that project.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Service role key for check_rls. Sent only to your Supabase project, never printed.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Supabase management token for check_rls and the auth config check. Sent only to the Supabase management API.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Supabase project ref, used with SUPABASE_MGMT_TOKEN.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Stripe secret key for check_stripe. Sent only to api.stripe.com, never printed.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Project-scoped Vercel token for check_vercel_env. Sent only to api.vercel.com, never printed.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Vercel project id for check_vercel_env.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Set to 1 to let check_vercel_env fetch decrypted variable values from api.vercel.com for the trailing-newline and live-key checks. Without it only names and targets are read and those checks are reported as skipped.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Set to 1 to let check_rls send the service key to a self-hosted Supabase URL. Without it the key is sent only to an https URL on a Supabase-hosted domain.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Folders, separated by the OS path delimiter, that scan_repo may read in addition to the server's working directory. Anything outside is refused.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop the server appending each run (grade, score, counts, failing check ids; never evidence) to .securealy/history.json in its working directory.

config.label: Optional, off by default
config.description: Optional, off by default. Set to 1 to send an anonymous aggregate of each run (command, grade, counts, stack kind, failing check ids; no URL, host or evidence) to securealy.com.
